svg.title: How every lane is checked
svg.desc: Tests at every width, hard cases, planted faults, the machine code, a nightly sweep and fuzz, and numbered lemmas where the code departs from the C.

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six layers, each against StrictMath or against the

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: machine code.

svg.text: Tests at every width

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each lane against StrictMath by raw bits, at every

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: width the host has, masked and unmasked.

svg.text: Hard cases

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inputs near a rounding boundary: Lefèvre's tables,

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: CORE-MATH's MIT lists for hypot and pow, exact

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cases computed for both.

svg.text: Planted faults

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deliberate bugs, each switched on in a JVM of its

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: own; the check named for it must fail.

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The machine code

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What C2 emits: the width's registers, no fused

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: multiply-add, from 256 bits up no stray call; and

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: an allocation check.

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every night, x86 and Arm

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: All 2^32 high words, three low words each (on x86

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at 128 bits, a 1/32 slice a night; one argument a

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: night for two), and a fuzz.

svg.text: Lemmas where the code departs

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Written arguments in PROOFS.md; parts of those for

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: exp, log and expm1 machine-checked by Z3 and cvc5.

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Everywhere else, the code is fdlibm's C, operation by

text.font-family: Inter, 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: operation, and the tests compare it with StrictMath.
